steps.name: Raspberry and Lemon Curd Tarts
steps.text: Prepare the Lemon Curd. Heat a bainmarie on medium-low heat. Add butter and wait for it to melt. Then add lemon juice, zest, raspberry juice, sugar, and eggs and whisk together until sugar melts into the mix and stir continuously. The lemon curd should begin to thicken and small bubbles will begin to form on the surface, about 40 minutes. Remove from heat once the lemon curd is thick enough for the whisk to leave marks on the surface.

steps.name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
steps.text: In a non-stick pan, on medium to high heat, add seasoned chicken breast. Cook for 5-10 mins, stirring regularly, until chicken breast is cooked through, showing a golden-brown colour all over and slightly charred.

steps.name: Mushroom Doner Kebab
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C, fan 180 degrees C, gas 6. Line a large roasting tray with baking paper, remove the stalks from the mushrooms and place them on the tray.

steps.name: Tuna Pasta Salad
steps.text: Add the tuna, coriander, beans, spinach, bell peppers, carrots, celery, onion, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, and spinach. At this point, you can cover the bowl and refrigerate it until you're ready to serve, up to 6 hours.

steps.name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry with Rice
steps.text: Add the onions and when they start to sizzle add the whole spices and chillies. Cook on a low heat until the onions are starting to brown.

steps.name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
steps.text: Build the wraps: On a tortilla wrap, add shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, chopped onion, spicy chicken and creamy hot sauce, then wrap into a burrito shaped roll or whatever shape desired.

steps.name: Carrot Soup
steps.text: Heat butter in a pot over medium heat until the butter melts. Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir in carrots and mix until properly coated. Add water and broth; bring to a lively simmer over high heat.  Reduce heat to maintain a lively simmer and cook until very tender, about 25 minutes.

steps.name: Spanish Tortilla
steps.text: Peel the potatoes and chop them into small chunks.

steps.name: Date Balls
steps.text: Place butter and pitted dates in a pan and heat until dates are soft.

steps.name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
steps.text: To a large mixing bowl, add chicken breast, 1 tbsp of olive oil, oregano, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and lemon juice, then mix until combined.

steps.name: Mushroom Doner Kebab
steps.text: Meanwhile, finely dice the tomatoes and finely slice the red onion. Mix with the zingy lemon juice and season well. Set aside.

steps.name: Vermicelli Rice with Meat
steps.text: The meat: Sweat one chopped onion in a pot, for a few minutes and then add minced garlic, then place the meat in the pot and on high heat while continuing stirring let the meat cook until the red color turns into more brownish, the idea here is not to fully cook the meat, but perhaps to get all the water out, this will help to get rid of all the water residue that comes out of the meat.

steps.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps.text: Add the carrot, celery, bell peppers, and mushrooms and cook for a further 2-3 minutes.

steps.name: Thai Red Curry
steps.text: Add the chicken chunks in (they should have been cooked 80%)

steps.name: Sfesiha (Lebanese Meat Pies)
steps.text: STUFFING. Start preparing the meat stuffing. Sweat one chopped onion in a pot, for a few minutes and then add minced garlic, then place the meat in the pot and on high heat while continuing stirring let the meat cook until the red color turns into more brownish, the idea here is not to fully cook the meat, but perhaps to get all the water out, this will help to get rid of all the water residue that comes out of the meat so it can help the meat stick to the dough while baking.

steps.name: Lazy Cake Recipe
steps.text: Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture

steps.name: Cacio e Pepe
steps.text: While the pasta cooks, add freshly grated parmigano cheese to the crushed black peppercorns on very low heat. Gradually add a cup of the boiling cooking water to the bowl, constantly mixing and adjusting as necessary to melt the cheese and obtain a silky, smooth sauce that’s able to completely coat the pasta. Finish with a knob of butter to emulsify the sauce

steps.name: Chicken Cheese Balls
steps.text: In separate pots, boil the chicken and potatoes until cooked through.

steps.name: Marinated Chicken with Soy Sauce
steps.text: Mix all the ingredients except for the chicken. Pour into a large container and add the chicken thighs.

steps.name: Raspberry and Lemon Curd Tarts
steps.text: In the meantime, prepare the puff pastry. Roll out the puff pastry to about 10 inches by 14 inches, then cut into squares.

steps.name: Stir Fry
steps.text: Next, add in the vegetables and nuts and fry for 2 minutes. Cook in batches so as not to overload the pan and boil them.

steps.name: Chicken Cheese Balls
steps.text: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

steps.name: Lazy Cake Recipe
steps.text: Start by mixing the melted butter, sweetened condensed milk with the cocoa powder. Combine them really well together, but it's okay if there are a few small lumps.

steps.name: Chicken Cheese Balls
steps.text: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

steps.name: Mango Lassi
steps.text: Add mangoes, ice cubes, cold water, honey, coconut milk, and yogurt to blender.

steps.name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
steps.text: Build the wraps: On a tortilla wrap, add shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, chopped onion, spicy chicken and creamy hot sauce, then wrap into a burrito shaped roll or whatever shape desired.

steps.name: Dal Makhani with Rice
steps.text: Add chopped onions to the pan. Cook the onion for around 6 to 7 minutes or until it turns light golden brown. Keep stirring it continuously so that it doesn't burn and keep heat on medium. Add chopped tomato to the pan and saute them with onions.

steps.name: Peas Pulao
steps.text: Slice 1 medium onion and slit few green chilies. Grate ginger and few cloves of garlic.

steps.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps.text: Wash and chop the fresh chestnut and shiitake mushrooms.

steps.name: Carrot Soup
steps.text: Puree the soup in batches in a blender until smooth. (Use caution when pureeing hot liquids.) Stir in spice mix and fresh coriander.

steps.name: Cheese Straws
steps.text: On a lightly floured surface, roll out to the thickness of a 1 pound coin. Cut into 1cm strips, then twist the strips 3-4 times.

steps.name: Spanish Tortilla
steps.text: Fry the potatoes on a medium-heat pan with abundant oil turning the potatoes frequently so that they don't burn. Split larger chunks with a spatula as they soften while cooking to ensure an even size of chunks. Add a pinch of salt while frying the potatoes.

steps.name: Chopped Chickpea Salad
steps.text: Rinse the chickpeas, then place the chickpeas on a towel and lightly towel dry them so they aren't wet from rinsing. You can remove any loose skins at this time too.

steps.name: Southwestern Salad
steps.text: Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.

steps.name: Chicken Tabbouleh Salad
steps.text: Chop carrot, coriander and avocado and add to bowl with tabbouleh salad.

steps.name: Bacon and Egg Sandwich
steps.text: To serve, cut the baguette in half and butter both sides. Add the bacon, scrambled eggs, and cheese.

steps.name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
steps.text: In a separate small bowl, combine fat free yoghurt, sriracha hot sauce, parsley, salt, pepper and lemon juice until smooth.

steps.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until the onion softens.

steps.name: Hibiscus Drink
steps.text: Add the Hibiscus (Zobo) flowers and chopped ginger into a pot a fill with water

steps.name: Banana Bread Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps.text: Use a cookie scoop or a spoon to scoop out about 1 inch dough balls. Place 2 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheet

steps.name: Thai Red Curry
steps.text: Add in the chopped vegetables (courgette, bamboo shoots and chili. Chili is optional)

steps.name: Carbonara with Side Salad
steps.text: Slice the bacon and place in a non-stick frying pan on a medium heat with half a tablespoon of olive oil and a really good pinch of black pepper. Leave it to get super-golden and crispy, tossing occasionally, then add the peas

steps.name: Southwestern Salad
steps.text: Wash and peel the sweet potatoes and chop into bite-sized pieces. Put the sweet potatoes in a bowl and add the olive oil, cumin, and chili powder. Mix well and pour the mixture onto a baking tray. Roast for 10 minutes.

steps.name: Hibiscus Drink
steps.text: Add sugar, give it a good stir and leave to cool.

steps.name: Chopped Salad and Bread
steps.text: Next, chop your cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, carrot, coriander, and red onion, and add them to a large bowl alongside the beans and diced tomatoes.

steps.name: Raspberry and Lemon Curd Tarts
steps.text: Layer the cooled raspberry lemon curd onto the top of the tart. Serve immediately. Store any leftovers in the refrigerator.

steps.name: Chocolate Pudding
steps.text: Put the egg and egg yolk in a large bowl with the sugar and a pinch of salt. Vigorously whisk by hand or with electric beaters, until the mixture is pale yellow and voluminous. Very gently fold in the melted chocolate mixture with a large metal spoon, taking care not to knock too much air out of the batter. Repeat with the flour.

steps.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps.text: Add the minced beef and cook for 5-6 minutes, until browned. Stir often, breaking up any large chunks of meat with a spatula.

steps.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps.text: Add the tomato pasta sauce, oregano, tinned tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Stir and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat and simmer for 15 -20 minutes until thickened.

steps.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps.text: When the rice is cooked take the pan off the heat, add butter and scatter over grated parmesan or Grana Padano cheese and tear and scatter a handful of parsley leaves. Chop the rest of the parsley and save for later.
